site-language={{ site.language.key }} languages={% for language in site.languages %}{{ language.key }}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %} default-language={{ site.default_language.key }} page-language={{ page.language.key }} translation-key={{ page.translation_key }} translations={% for translation in page.translations %}{{ translation.language.key }}={{ translation.url }}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %} all-translations={% for translation in page.all_translations %}{{ translation.language.key }}={{ translation.url }}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %} alternates={% for alternate in page.alternates %}{{ alternate.tag }}={{ alternate.url }}{% if alternate.x_default %}=x-default{% endif %}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %} shared={{ site.data.settings.shared }} locale-value={{ site.data.settings.locale }} nested={{ site.data.settings.nested.shared }}/{{ site.data.settings.nested.locale }} message={{ "nav.home" | translate }} {% if page.translation_key == "about" %} page-lookup={{ page | localized_url: "de" }} route-lookup={{ "/about/" | localized_url: "de" }} route-query-fragment={{ "/about/?source=fixture#section" | localized_url: "de" }} foreign-route-lookup={{ "/de/uber-uns/" | localized_url: "en" }} shared-asset={{ "/assets/site.css" | localized_url: "de" }} external={{ "https://cdn.example.test/app.js" | localized_url: "de" }} fragment={{ "#section" | localized_url: "de" }} relative={{ "/about/" | relative_url }} absolute={{ "/about/" | absolute_url }} {% endif %} posts={% for post in site.posts %}{{ post.title }}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %} guides={% for guide in site.guides %}{{ guide.title }}{% unless forloop.last %},{% endunless %}{% endfor %} {{ content }}
